items.text: Terry McLaurin will play; final update after GTD.
items.why: Confirmed active, likely limited but suited up.
items.implication: Commanders WR1 in; monitors snap share.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if healthy enough; Daniels returning too.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty is a go after pregame workout; earlier hopeful/GTD with plantar fasciitis/ankle.
items.why: Worked out pregame; elevated backup in case but cleared.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially inactive; chance to play next week.
items.opportunity: Monitor Bagent game script for pass catchers.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is active today vs. the Saints. Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. inactive.
items.why: Pregame determination; homecoming motivation noted earlier.
items.implication: Jefferson full go; Addison out concentrates targets.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for Jefferson without Addison.

items.text: Jordan Addison inactive today for Vikings.
items.implication: No Addison; Jefferson and others absorb routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Reverse any prior Addison start plans.

items.text: FINAL UPDATES and earlier: Ja'Marr Chase will play vs Dolphins after questionable tag.
items.why: Weekend reports and official confirmation both WRs clear.
items.implication: Full Bengals WR duo available; no void in targets.

items.text: Tee Higgins will play vs Dolphins; listed questionable but cleared.
items.why: Confirmed with Chase in ETR/Schefter updates.
items.implication: Bengals pass game intact; limits upside for secondary options.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. inactive vs Lions as Cardinals finalize trade details; informed morning of.
items.why: Trade imminent; Texans among teams in mix.
items.implication: AZ WR corps without MHJ; Wilson/Bourne elevated.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson primary beneficiary in targets/routes.

items.text: NOT EXPECTED: Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison, Darius Slayton, Josh Palmer. EXPECTED: Zay Flowers, Carnell Tate, Rhamondre Stevenson, Alvin Kamara, Keenan Allen. GTD resolved later for others.
items.implication: Clear start/sit for listed; projections live.

items.text: Zay Flowers expected to play vs Falcons; questionable foot but expected.
items.implication: Ravens WR1 in with Huntley at QB.
items.opportunity: Standard usage; Likely also in mix.

items.text: Ladd McConkey not expected to play vs Broncos; foot injury, no practice.
items.implication: Chargers WR void; boosts other pass catchers.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (back) expected to play vs Vikings.
Rico Dowdle unlikely to play vs Colts; toe injury, final determination in warmups but expectation out.
items.why: Toe; Steelers will decide warmups but Schefter/ETR not expected.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games. He wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. Kia Kendrick Bourne szn with inactive/trade.
items.why: MHJ low production historically this year; inactive seals Wilson/Bourne path.
items.implication: Wilson becomes viable WR play vs DET; not just temporary.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; MHJ inactive/trade boost + volume.
items.why: MHJ non-factor and now inactive; target volume vs DET secondary.
items.opportunity: Primary AZ WR targets/routes without MHJ.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs soft defense.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift; red-zone volume.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injuries context + soft run D.
Hates Jordan Addison (injury + role), Mark Andrews, Cam Skattebo, Tony Pollard, Jalen Hurts (rough stretch/banged line vs JAX London).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency concerns, injuries.
items.implication: Fade in start/sit; Addison confirmed inactive amplifies.
